data.name: Header.ThemeTooltip
data.value: Color scheme - System follows the operating system.

data.name: Header.RunInBackgroundTooltip
data.value: Close to the notification area instead of quitting - fan control keeps running in the background.

data.name: MainWindow.ApplyChangesTooltip
data.value: Apply - applies the unsaved changes, saved via the background service.

data.name: MainWindow.RevertTooltip
data.value: Discard - discards all changes since the last save.

data.name: MainWindow.DaemonUnreachable
data.value: Background service unreachable - is the service running? Check with: systemctl status linfan-daemon

data.name: MainWindow.ProfileActiveTooltip
data.value: Hands the fans to this profile. Apply pending changes first - the service would switch to its saved copy of the profile, not to what is on screen.

data.name: MainWindow.ProfileSwitchLocked
data.value: Locked while changes are unsaved - apply or revert them first.

data.name: MainWindow.OpenCurveTooltip
data.value: Opens this curve in the editor.

data.name: MainWindow.ProfileCurvesSubtitle
data.value: Click a curve to edit it; the side menu lists them as well

data.name: MainWindow.ProfileNotActiveNote
data.value: This profile is not regulating right now - it can be edited without affecting the fans.

data.name: MainWindow.CurveToggleTooltip
data.value: Curve on/off - “off” sets the assigned fans to hardware auto.

data.name: MainWindow.EditCurveTooltip
data.value: Switches to the “Curves & assignment” tab and selects this curve.

data.name: MainWindow.ManualPowerTooltip
data.value: Manual fan power in % - only active in manual mode.

data.name: MainWindow.CalibrateTooltip
data.value: Determines the lowest PWM value at which this fan reliably starts.

data.name: MainWindow.SensorListSubtitle
data.value: Live temperature · display name, group & visibility

data.name: MainWindow.HideHiddenSensorsTooltip
data.value: Hides hidden sensors from this list too (does not delete them).

data.name: MainWindow.ToggleVisibleSensorTooltip
data.value: Show/hide everywhere except the settings (still measured).

data.name: MainWindow.GroupSensorTooltip
data.value: Groups sensors into one block - same name = one block, in the dashboard and in the curves sensor pickers. Empty → “Ungrouped”.

data.name: MainWindow.FanListSubtitle
data.value: Live speed · name, position, group & visibility

data.name: MainWindow.HideHiddenFansTooltip
data.value: Hides hidden fans from this list too (still controlled).

data.name: MainWindow.ToggleVisibleFanTooltip
data.value: Show/hide everywhere except the settings (still controlled).

data.name: MainWindow.PositionLabelTooltip
data.value: Mounting position / airflow direction - basis for the planned airflow tuning.

data.name: MainWindow.PickLocationTooltip
data.value: Choose the mounting position in the case (interactive preview).

data.name: MainWindow.MinTooltip
data.value: Lower limit: the fan is never driven below this power (start point).

data.name: MainWindow.MaxTooltip
data.value: Upper limit: the fan is never driven above this power.

data.name: MainWindow.IdentifyTooltip
data.value: Briefly spins the fan up to 100% (others are throttled) to identify it physically.

data.name: MainWindow.ManualControlTooltip
data.value: Temporarily control the fan by hand to identify it physically. Reverts to curve/auto when the section is collapsed.

data.name: MainWindow.ManualPwmFloorHint
data.value: 0% is the hardware floor - some fans keep a minimum speed there and cannot be switched off entirely. For reliable identification use the pulse button (Identify) instead.

data.name: MainWindow.AirflowAutoTuneSubtitle
data.value: Derives a pressure balance and matching curves from the mounting positions. Review the suggestion, apply it, then save.

data.name: MainWindow.AirflowStatusSubtitle
data.value: These fans follow the airflow analysis' role curves in the profile being edited.

data.name: MainWindow.AnalyzeAirflowTooltip
data.value: Computes the pressure balance and matching curve suggestions from the fan positions.

data.name: MainWindow.ApplySuggestionTooltip
data.value: Loads the checked curves/assignments into the editor - then apply via Save.

data.name: MainWindow.AddProfileTooltip
data.value: Creates an empty profile with a default curve.

data.name: MainWindow.NoDevicesForCurves
data.value: No devices detected - without sensors and fans no curves can be created.

data.name: MainWindow.CurveDisabledTooltip
data.value: Curve disabled - fans on hardware auto.

data.name: MainWindow.NoSourceSensor
data.value: No source sensor selected - no live operating point.

data.name: MainWindow.ToggleAllSensorsTooltip
data.value: Shows or hides the remaining source sensors.

data.name: MainWindow.MixTooltip
data.value: How multiple source sensors are combined: Max (warmest) or Avg (mean).

data.name: MainWindow.InterpolationTooltip
data.value: Linear = straight between the points. Step = holds a level and jumps at the next point. Spline = smooth rounded curve through the points.

data.name: MainWindow.HysteresisTooltip
data.value: Dead band in °C: prevents constant readjustment on small temperature fluctuations.

data.name: MainWindow.SmoothingTooltip
data.value: Averages the temperature over this many seconds before the curve is applied. Absorbs the brief spikes that make fans surge and drop back (typical of AMD CPUs). 0 turns it off. The over-temperature protection is unaffected and keeps reacting immediately.

data.name: MainWindow.DecreasingPercentWarning
data.value: Power drops as temperature rises - the fan then cools less the hotter it gets.

data.name: MainWindow.AddPointTooltip
data.value: Adds a point to the curve.

data.name: MainWindow.FansOfCurveSubtitle
data.value: Check which fans use the selected curve

data.name: Onboarding.WelcomeIntro
data.value: This assistant sets up LinFan for your system. It guides you through calibrating the fans and choosing a working profile.

data.name: Onboarding.WelcomeSkipHint
data.value: You can skip the assistant at any time and adjust the settings later in the main window.

data.name: Onboarding.CalibrationIntro
data.value: For each controllable fan this first couples its speed sensor (spins the fan up, assigns the tacho that responds), then calibrates the lowest PWM value at which it still starts. Fans without a tacho are skipped.

data.name: Onboarding.DevicesIntro
data.value: Optional: assign each fan its mounting position (the basis for airflow tuning) and choose which sensors LinFan shows.

data.name: Onboarding.IdentifyTooltip
data.value: Briefly spins the fan up to 100 % (others are throttled) to identify it physically.

data.name: Onboarding.PickLocationTooltip
data.value: Choose the mounting position in the case (interactive preview).

data.name: Onboarding.ManualControlTooltip
data.value: Temporarily control the fan by hand (0 % = hardware floor; some fans keep a minimum speed there). Reverts to auto when you leave this step.

data.name: Onboarding.SensorsHint
data.value: Deselected sensors are hidden everywhere except the settings (still measured). Sensors without a current reading are hidden by default.

data.name: Onboarding.AirflowProfilesIntro
data.value: Fan positions detected: all three profiles are built from the airflow analysis - every fan follows a curve for its role (CPU, GPU, intake, exhaust).

data.name: Onboarding.PrimarySensorHint
data.value: This sensor drives all fan curves - usually the CPU sensor.

data.name: Onboarding.DoneIntro
data.value: LinFan is now set up. Here's how to find your way around the main window:

data.name: Onboarding.DoneOverview
data.value: • Overview - keep an eye on live temperatures, fan speeds and the active curves.

data.name: Onboarding.DoneCurves
data.value: • Curves & assignment - adjust fan curves, assign fans and switch profiles.

data.name: Onboarding.DoneSettings
data.value: • Settings - rename devices, adjust positions and visibility, or run the airflow analysis and this assistant again.

data.name: FanLocationDialog.HardwareFloorHint
